apps.name: 神荒武界❤️武侠大世界（高武/开局roll/中消耗/玄幻/武侠/大世界）
apps.description:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>神荒武界-九重天阙</title>
<style>
:root {
    --gold: #d4af37;
    --deep-gold: #aa8c2c;
    --dark-bg: #0a0a0a;
    --card-bg: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.95);
    --border-color: #3d3420;
    --text-color: #e0e0e0;
    --sub-text: #888;
}
* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
@keyframes floatSmoke {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0.05; }
  33% { transform: translate(20px, -20px) rotate(120deg); opacity: 0.08; }
  66% { transform: translate(-15px, 15px) rotate(240deg); opacity: 0.03; }
}
@keyframes pulseGlowBackground {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}
body::after {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: 
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.03) 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(170, 140, 44, 0.02) 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 40% 80%, rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.01) 0%, transparent 50%);
  z-index: -2;
  animation: pulseGlowBackground 8s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
display: none;
}
.smoke-particle {
  position: fixed;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: blur(20px);
}
.smoke-particle:nth-child(1) {
  width: 300px;
  height: 300px;
  top: 10%;
  left: 10%;
  animation: floatSmoke 25s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.smoke-particle:nth-child(2) {
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  top: 60%;
  right: 15%;
  animation: floatSmoke 30s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
}
.smoke-particle:nth-child(3) {
  width: 250px;
  height: 250px;
  bottom: 20%;
  left: 20%;
  animation: floatSmoke 20s ease-in-out infinite;
}
body, html {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background-color: var(--dark-bg);
    color: var(--text-color);
    font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", serif;
    line-height: 1.8;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="%23d4af37" d="M12,2L4.5,20.29L5.21,21L12,18L18.79,21L19.5,20.29L12,2Z"/></svg>'), auto;
    background-image: url('https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEPsblpawf-6SNcc-oVXwOf-5OmDp-FAgACohoAArMxWVcXqLhCnrHX5zgE.jpg');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center center;
    background-attachment: fixed;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
}
body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);  : -1;
    pointer-events: none;
}
#loading-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #000 url('https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEPsblpawf-6SNcc-oVXwOf-5OmDp-FAgACohoAArMxWVcXqLhCnrHX5zgE.jpg') no-repeat center center;
    background-size: cover; 
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    z-index: 9999;
    transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
    overflow: hidden;
}
#loading-overlay::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(
        to bottom,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65) 30%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 70%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)
    );
    z-index: 1;
}
#loading-overlay > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}
.scroll-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 300px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 600px;
}
.scroll-paper {
    width: 0;
    height: 220px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, 
        rgba(26, 21, 15, 0.95), 
        rgba(44, 36, 25, 0.9), 
        rgba(26, 21, 15, 0.95)
    );
    backdrop-filter: blur(3px); 
    border-top: 2px solid var(--gold);
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    animation: unfoldPaper 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.5s forwards;
  box-shadow: 
    0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
    0 0 60px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3); 
}
.scroll-rod {
    width: 25px;
    height: 260px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #5c4a16, #d4af37, #8a7024, #d4af37, #5c4a16);
    border-radius: 4px;
    z-index: 10;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
    position: absolute;
}
.rod-left {
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    animation: moveRodLeft 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.5s forwards;
}
.rod-right {
    right: 50%;
    transform: translateX(50%);
    animation: moveRodRight 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.5s forwards;
}
@keyframes unfoldPaper {
    0% { width: 0; }
    100% { width: 80%; }
}
@keyframes moveRodLeft {
    0% { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    100% { left: 10%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
@keyframes moveRodRight {
    0% { right: 50%; transform: translateX(50%); }
    100% { right: 10%; transform: translateX(50%); }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .list-item {
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        padding: 10px 8px;
        word-wrap: break-word;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        max-width: 100%;
        overflow: visible;
        min-height: auto;
    }
    .fold-section {
        position: relative;
    }
    .collapsible-content:not(.collapsed) {
        overflow-y: visible; 
        max-height: none; 
        padding-bottom: 10px; 
        height: auto;
    }
    #rule .list-item .item-desc {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
        white-space: normal;
        overflow: visible;
        max-height: none;
    }
    .scroll-wrapper {
        height: 250px;
    }
    .scroll-paper {
        height: 180px;
    }
    .scroll-rod {
        height: 220px;
        width: 18px;
    }
    @keyframes unfoldPaper {
        0% { width: 0; }
        100% { width: 85%; }
    }
    @keyframes moveRodLeft {
        0% { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        100% { left: 7.5%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    @keyframes moveRodRight {
        0% { right: 50%; transform: translateX(50%); }
        100% { right: 7.5%; transform: translateX(50%); }
    }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .scroll-wrapper {
        height: 220px;
    }
    .scroll-paper {
        height: 150px;
    }
    .scroll-rod {
        height: 190px;
        width: 16px;
    }
}
.scroll-content {
    opacity: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    animation: fadeInContent 1s ease 2s forwards;
}
@keyframes fadeInContent {
    to { opacity: 1; }
}
.scroll-content {
    text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.scroll-content h2 {
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-shadow: 
        0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.7),
        0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    font-size: 2.5rem; 
    font-weight: bold;
}
.scroll-content p {
    color: #f5e8c6; 
    letter-spacing: 5px;
    margin: 5px 0;
    font-size: 1.2rem; 
    text-shadow: 
        0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5),
        0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
.scroll-content .subtext {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #b3a16e;
    font-style: italic;
    margin-top: 15px;
    text-shadow: 
        0 0 8px rgba(179, 161, 110, 0.4),
        0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.skip-btn {
    margin-top: 40px;
    padding: 12px 30px;
    background: rgba(20, 15, 10, 0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(5px); 
    border: 2px solid var(--gold); 
    border-radius: 4px; 
    color: var(--gold);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 1rem;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: btnFadeIn 1s ease-out 2.5s forwards;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    box-shadow: 
        0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3),
        inset 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
.skip-btn:hover {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #0a0a0a;
    box-shadow: 
        0 0 30px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.7),
        inset 0 0 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}
@keyframes btnFadeIn {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .scroll-content h2 {
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        letter-spacing: 6px;
    }
    .scroll-content p {
        font-size: 1rem;
        letter-spacing: 3px;
    }
    .scroll-content .subtext {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .scroll-content h2 {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        letter-spacing: 4px;
    }
    .scroll-content p {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
    }
}
.main-container {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.95), rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.95));
    min-height: 100vh;
    box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
    display: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.main-container {
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(180%);
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.92),
    rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.95)
  ) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 
    0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9),
    0 0 100px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) inset,
    0 0 30px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
}
.content-section {
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
  background: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.88) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  box-shadow: 
    inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7),
    0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.content-section:hover {
  border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 
    inset 0 0 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 0 30px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}
.scroll-paper {
  position: relative;
  overflow: visible !important;
}
.scroll-paper::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -10px;
  left: -10px;
  right: -10px;
  bottom: -10px;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, 
    transparent 30%, 
    rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) 50%, 
    transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 4px;
  z-index: -1;
  animation: scrollGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  filter: blur(15px);
}
@keyframes scrollGlow {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { opacity: 0.7; }
}
h1 {
    color: var(--gold);
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 2rem;
    letter-spacing: 5px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color);
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
    position: relative;
}
h1::before, h1::after {
    content: "❖";
    position: static; 
    color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    opacity: 0.5;
    top: auto; 
    transform: none; 
}
h1::before { 
}
h1::after { 
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    h1 {
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        letter-spacing: 3px;
    }
    h1::before { 
        left: calc(50% - 110px); 
    }
    h1::after { 
        right: calc(50% - 110px); 
    }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    h1 {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
    }
    h1::before { 
        left: calc(50% - 90px); 
    }
    h1::after { 
        right: calc(50% - 90px); 
    }
}
h2, h3 {
    color: var(--deep-gold);
    padding-left: 15px;
    margin-top: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    position: relative;
}
h3::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 4px;
    height: 70%;
    background: var(--gold);
}
h3 .toggle-icon {
    font-size: 0.8em;
    margin-left: 10px;
    color: var(--gold);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}
h3.collapsed .toggle-icon {
    transform: rotate(-90deg);
}
h4 { 
    color: #ccc; 
    margin: 15px 0 5px 0; 
    font-size: 1.1rem; 
    border-left: 3px solid var(--deep-gold);
    padding-left: 10px;
}
.collapsible-content {
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.3s ease;
    max-height: 2000px;
    opacity: 1;
}
.collapsible-content.collapsed {
    max-height: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.category-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    margin-left: 10px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}
.tag-top { background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2); color: #ff6666; border: 1px solid #ff3333; }
.tag-mid { background: rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.2); color: #ffb366; border: 1px solid #ff9900; }
.tag-low { background: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.2); color: #aaa; border: 1px solid #666; }
.tab-nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 30px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
}
.tab-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    color: #666;
    padding: 10px 25px;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: 0.3s;
    position: relative;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-weight: bold;
}
.tab-btn:hover { color: var(--gold); }
.tab-btn.active {
    color: var(--gold);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
.tab-content {
    display: none;
    animation: fadeIn 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.tab-content.active { display: block; }
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.tab-content {
  animation: tabSwitch 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}
@keyframes tabSwitch {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.98);
    filter: blur(5px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}
.collapsible-content {
  transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}
.collapsible-content:not(.collapsed) {
  animation: contentReveal 0.5s ease-out;
}
@keyframes contentReveal {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.content-section {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    padding: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    box-shadow: 
        inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8),
        0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.world-text {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #bbb;
    text-align: justify;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    text-indent: 2em;
}
.list-item {
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    padding: 10px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    border-left: 2px solid #555;
    transition: 0.3s;
    position: relative;
}
.list-item:hover {
    border-left-color: var(--gold);
    background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
}
.list-item::before {
    content: "»";
    position: absolute;
    left: -15px;
    color: var(--gold);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
.list-item:hover::before {
    opacity: 1;
}
.item-title { 
    color: var(--gold); 
    font-weight: bold; 
    font-size: 1.05rem; 
    display: block; 
    margin-bottom: 5px; 
}
.item-desc { 
    color: #999; 
    font-size: 0.9rem; 
    margin: 0; 
}
.red-mark { 
    color: #ff4d4d; 
    font-weight: bold; 
}
label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center; 
    color: var(--deep-gold);
    margin-top: 20px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    gap: 8px; 
}
label::before {
    content: "◆";
    color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.7);
    font-size: 0.8em;
    flex-shrink: 0; 
}
.input-with-dice {
    position: relative;
    margin-top: 5px;
}
.input-with-dice input, 
.input-with-dice select, 
.input-with-dice textarea {
    width: 100%;
    background: #111;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    color: #fff;
    padding: 12px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: 0.3s;
    border-radius: 2px;
}
.custom-input {
    width: 100%;
    background: #111;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    color: #fff;
    padding: 12px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: 0.3s;
    border-radius: 2px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: none;
}
.custom-input:focus {
    border-color: var(--gold);
    background: #151515;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
    outline: none;
}
.input-with-dice textarea {
    min-height: 100px;
    resize: vertical;
    padding-right: 45px; 
}
.talent-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 20px;
}
.talent-card {
    background: #151515;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    padding: 12px 8px;
    text-align: center; 
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center; 
    align-items: center; 
    min-height: 60px;
}
.talent-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    z-index: 10;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
.talent-card.selected {
    border-color: var(--gold);
    background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold);
}
.talent-card.locked {
    border-color: #ffcc00;
    background: rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.1);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.5);
}
.talent-card.locked.selected {
    border-color: #ffcc00;
    background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.5), 0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5);
}
.lock-icon {
    position: absolute;
    top: 5px;
    right: 5px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #666;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    z-index: 5;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border-radius: 3px;
}
.lock-icon:hover {
    color: #ffcc00;
    transform: scale(1.2);
}
.talent-card.locked .lock-icon {
    color: #ffcc00;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.8);
}
.talent-name {
    font-weight: bold;
    width: 100%; 
    text-align: center; 
    padding: 0 5px;

function rollSkill() {
    const btn = event.target.closest('.dice-btn');
    animateDice(btn);
    const rand = Math.random() * 100;
    let skillPool = [];
    if (rand < 3) skillPool = skillsData["帝阶"];
    else if (rand < 8) skillPool = skillsData["圣阶"];
    else if (rand < 15) skillPool = skillsData["神阶"];
    else if (rand < 30) skillPool = skillsData["天阶"];
    else if (rand < 50) skillPool = skillsData["地阶"];
    else if (rand < 75) skillPool = skillsData["玄阶"];
    else skillPool = skillsData["人阶"];
    const skill = skillPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * skillPool.length)];
    document.getElementById('char-skill').value = skill;
    updatePreview();
}

    {n:"佛魔一念·明心",q:7,d:"大雷音寺护法金刚，佛门战僧。修《圣·大日如来金身》，左眼慈悲如佛，右眼凶戾如魔，一念成佛一念成魔。可助净化心魔，同时吸收佛力魔力，但佛门戒律森严，需面对佛法两难。（此天赋让你与他有不错初始好感）"},
{n:"大周长公主·姬瑶光",q:7,d:"大周皇朝长公主,你已得她初始好感，身负皇族血脉，可借国运之力。与其结为道侣可获得皇室顶级资源与传承，但需面对皇室审查与朝臣非议，且她占有欲极强，可能会金屋藏你。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
{n:"大周贵妃·苏倾城",q:6,d:"大周皇帝最宠爱的贵妃，精通媚术与后宫权谋。你已与她相识得初始关系，与其结为道侣可获得媚术传承与后宫资源，双修效果极佳，但她会为你不顾一切私奔，需面对整个大周皇朝的追杀。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
{n:"碧波传人·上官虹",q:6,d:"当今碧波门唯一门主，天生剑心，剑道天赋惊人。你已与她相识，与其结为道侣可获得剑道传承，她会成为你的剑道伴侣，但需面对振兴宗门的考验，且她对剑道的执着可能会让你感到压力。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
    {n:"仁者天生",q:6,d:"心怀苍生，仁德感天。以仁心驾驭无上力量，施展治疗、防御类功法神通效果倍增，功德加身。"},
    {n:"惊世智慧",q:6,d:"智慧通天，谋略如神。过目不忘只是基础，可于纷乱中窥见唯一生机，推演功法、布局天下如同掌上观纹，但容易自作聪明。"},
    {n:"聂家疯血",q:6,d:"祖传特殊血脉，遭遇强敌或情绪极度激动时会陷入疯狂状态，战力暴增数倍，不畏伤痛，但敌我不分，有失控风险。疯狂过后会陷入虚弱。"},
    {n:"天剑之境",q:6,d:"剑道至高境界之一，心中无剑，天地万物皆可为剑。举手投足蕴含无上剑意，对剑类兵器有绝对统御力，可感知千里范围内名剑气息。"},
{n:"天地一刀",q:6,d:"刀道至高境界之一。心中无招，万象皆可为刀。拔刀即是天地，收刀即是寂灭。对世间万兵有天然压制之势，可引动万里山河刀意共鸣。"},
    {n:"先天元阳炁",q:6,d:"诞生时伴有一缕先天纯阳本源，至刚至正，万邪不侵。修炼阳刚类功法事半功倍，元气恢复速度极快，但需注意阴阳平衡，避免燥热伤身。"},
    {n:"先天玄阴炁",q:6,d:"诞生时伴有一缕先天纯阴本源，至柔至寒，冻结万物。修炼阴柔类功法进展神速，元气绵长无尽，但需调和阴阳，防止寒气反噬。"},
    {n:"不羁浪子·萧逸风",q:6,d:"听雨楼金牌杀手，代号'风中刀'。修《神·虚空听雨残卷》，化身阴影，无声取命。一刀修罗，可斩杀同境。重情重义，认定便一生守护，但听雨楼杀手身份可能带来追杀。（此天赋让你与他有不错初始好感）"},
    {n:"大雷音寺佛女·净莲",q:6,d:"佛门未来菩萨，天生九品莲台异象。身怀无上佛法神通，可助人净化心魔，但需遵守佛门戒律，且佛门护法金刚会时刻监视。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
    {n:"听雨楼楼主·幽影",q:6,d:"天下第一情报组织首领，掌握半个江湖的秘密。得她青睐可获得顶级情报支持，但也可能卷入无数江湖阴谋与仇杀。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
    {n:"葶苧苑苑主·商葶苧",q:6,d:"武道医仙，医术惊人，乐善好施。得她青睐可获得完美的医疗资料，不怕任何受伤，但你也要肯定她的医者之道。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
    {n:"真龙烈血",q:6,d:"体内流淌传说真龙之血，肉身极强。元气可化龙形，施展血脉神通。"},
    {n:"神象镇狱",q:6,d:"体内八亿四千万微粒觉醒神象之力。一吼落星辰，举手投足镇压传说地狱恶鬼威能。"},
    {n:"九窍玲珑心",q:6,d:"心生九窍，悟性通神。任何功法无师自通，可推演万物，预知吉凶。"},
    {n:"不灭金身",q:6,d:"佛门武道至高体质。防御力举世无双，万劫不磨，死后肉身千年不腐。"},
    {n:"大梦千秋",q:6,d:"在梦中修炼，梦中一年现世一日。精神力极其庞大，可杀人于梦境之中。"},

    {n:"绝剑之境",q:5,d:"剑道极端境界，心中唯剑，绝情绝性。剑招威力惊天动地，追求一击必杀，对剑的执着可斩断虚幻，但情感会逐渐淡漠，有沦为剑奴的风险。"},
    {n:"铸神谷神匠·欧冶雪",q:5,d:"千年铸剑世家唯一传人，天生剑体。若钟情于你，可为你量身打造成长型神兵，并传授《神·神锻天书》，但需收集稀世神材。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},
    {n:"百花宫宫主·花想容",q:5,d:"百花宫当代宫主，身具天香媚骨。对你很感兴趣，双修可大幅提升修为，且精通上古丹方，但百花宫仇敌遍天下（因为坑各种男武者），需时时警惕。（此天赋让你与她有不错初始好感）"},

function toggleLockTalent(talentName, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const talentIndex = lockedTalents.findIndex(t => t.n === talentName);
    const isSelected = selectedTalents.some(t => t.n === talentName);
    if (talentIndex === -1) {
        if (lockedTalents.length >= 3) {
            alert("最多只能锁定3个天赋！");
            return;
        }
        const talentToLock = talentsData.find(t => t.n === talentName);
        if (talentToLock) {
            lockedTalents.push(talentToLock);
            updateLockedCount();
            if (!isSelected && selectedTalents.length < 3) {
                selectedTalents.push(talentToLock);
            }
        }
    } else {
        lockedTalents.splice(talentIndex, 1);
        updateLockedCount();
    }
    const talentCard = document.querySelector(`.talent-card[data-name="${talentName}"]`);
    if (talentCard) {
        talentCard.classList.toggle('locked');
        const lockIcon = talentCard.querySelector('.lock-icon');
        if (lockIcon) {
            lockIcon.textContent = talentCard.classList.contains('locked') ? '🔒' : '🔓';
        }
    }
    updatePreview();
}
function updateLockedCount() {
    const countElement = document.getElementById('locked-count');
    if (countElement) {
        countElement.textContent = `已锁定：${lockedTalents.length}/3`;
    }
}
function generateNewTalents(pool) {
    pool.classList.remove('terminal-mode');
    pool.innerHTML = '';
    let lockedCards = [];
    lockedTalents.forEach(lockedTalent => {
        lockedCards.push(lockedTalent);
    });
    const remainingTalents = talentsData.filter(t => 
        !lockedTalents.some(lt => lt.n === t.n)
    );
    const shuffled = [...remainingTalents].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const neededCount = 12 - lockedCards.length;
    const selectedNewTalents = shuffled.slice(0, neededCount);
    const allTalents = [...lockedCards, ...selectedNewTalents];
    allTalents.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).forEach(t => {
        const isLocked = lockedTalents.some(lt => lt.n === t.n);
        const isSelected = selectedTalents.some(st => st.n === t.n);
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = `talent-card q-${t.q} ${isLocked ? 'locked' : ''} ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}`;
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div class="lock-icon" onclick="toggleLockTalent('${t.n}', event)">${isLocked ? '🔒' : '🔓'}</div>
            <div class="talent-name">${t.n}</div>
        `;
        div.setAttribute('data-desc', t.d);
        div.setAttribute('data-name', t.n);
        div.setAttribute('data-quality', t.q);
        div.onmouseenter = (e) => {
            if(window.innerWidth > 600) {
                showTooltip(e, t.n, t.d, t.q);
            }
        };
        div.onmouseleave = hideTooltip;
        div.onclick = () => toggleTalent(div, t);
        pool.appendChild(div);
    });
    updatePreview();
}
function rollTalents() {
    const pool = document.getElementById('talent-pool');
    selectedTalents = selectedTalents.filter(t =>

    setTimeout(() => {

function showTooltip(e, name, desc, quality) {
    if(window.innerWidth <= 600) return;
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
    tooltip.style.display = 'block';
    tooltip.style.left = e.pageX + 15 + 'px';
    tooltip.style.top = e.pageY + 15 + 'px';
    tooltip.style.position = 'absolute';
    const colorMap = {7:'#ff3333',6:'#ffaa00',5:'#ffcc00',4:'#c770ff',3:'#3399ff',2:'#33ff33',1:'#ccc'};
    tooltip.innerHTML = `<span class="tooltip-title" style="color:${colorMap[quality]}">${name}</span>${desc}`;
}
function hideTooltip() {
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
    tooltip.style.display = 'none';
}
function toggleTalent(el, t) {
    const isLocked = lockedTalents.some(lt => lt.n === t.n);
    if (el.classList.contains('selected')) {
        if (isLocked) {
            alert("锁定的天赋不能取消选择！请先解锁。");
            return;
        }
        el.classList.remove('selected');
        selectedTalents = selectedTalents.filter(x => x.n !== t.n);
    } else {
        if (selectedTalents.length >= 3) {
            alert("最多只能选择三项天赋！");
            return;
        }
        el.classList.add('selected');
        selectedTalents.push(t);
    }
    updatePreview();
}
